text:
maria: Okay this is a crime scene. Caught Mabel mid-cheese-puff heist — she actually opened the bag with her tiny teeth. https://i.imgur.com/3xQZp9L.jpg :rotating_light:
jon: OMG that is peak sleuthing. Who trained her to unzip packaging? :joy:
leah: Mabel the Snack Bandit. Did you confiscate the loot or blame the crumbs on the dog? :eyes:
maria: Confiscated (tried to) — she gave me the Look of Betrayal and hid under the spice rack. Also left a tiny cheesy breadcrumb trail. :camera_with_flash:
parker: We should hamster-proof the pantry. Idea: build a tiny vault or at least add a lock. Code patch: `hamster_lock = True` :laughing:
sam: Petition to make Mabel the official office mascot? :raised_hands: (reaction :thumbsup: x5)
maria: Quick poll — react to this thread: :heart: = yes mascot, :neutral_face: = no mascot
giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/hamster-stuffing-snack-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI (gif)
jon: placing an order for hamster-sized office swag. tiny hoodies incoming. :tshirt: :rofl:
leah: Honestly I vote mascot AND tiny hoodies. If anyone brings cheese puffs we can blame Mabel for quality control. :cheese:
